    frpm."County Name" AS County,
    frpm."School Name" AS SchoolName,
    frpm."Charter School (Y/N)" AS CharterStatus,
    frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS Enrollment,
    frpm."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" AS FreeMealPercentage,

    frpm

    schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode

    satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE 
    schools.Virtual = 'F'

    satscores.NumGE1500,

    b.bond_id,
    b.bond_type,
    c.atom_id AS atom1,
    a1.element AS element1,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2,
    a2.element AS element2,
    CASE
        WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'

JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id

JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    b.bond_type,
    c.atom_id AS atom1,
    a1.element AS element1,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2,
    a2.element AS element2,
    CASE
        WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    m.label AS molecule_label
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    b.bond_type,
    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,
    CASE
        WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    m.label AS molecule_label,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = b.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = b.molecule_id) AS bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    b.bond_type,
    c.atom_id AS atom1,
    a1.element AS element1,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2,
    a2.element AS element2,
    CASE
        WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    m.label AS molecule_label,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    b.bond_type,
    c.atom_id AS atom1,
    a1.element AS element1,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2,
    a2.element AS element2,
    CASE
        WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    m.label AS molecule_label,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    b.bond_type,
    c.atom_id AS atom1,
    a1.element AS element1,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2,
    a2.element AS element2,

    m.label AS molecule_label,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS atom_count,

JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    b.bond_type,
    c.atom_id AS atom1,
    a1.element AS element1,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2,
    a2.element AS element2,

JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    b.bond_type,
    c.atom_id AS atom1,
    a1.element AS element1,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2,
    a2.element AS element2,

        WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    m.label AS molecule_label,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

    b.bond_type,
    c.atom_id AS atom1,

JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,

    c.atom_id AS atom1,
    a1.element AS element1,

JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT 
    ra.year,
    AVG(
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) +
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 10, 3) AS INTEGER) * 0.001
    ) AS average_time_seconds
FROM 
    driverStandings ds
JOIN 
    drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN 
    results r ON ds.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN 
    races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE 
    ds.position = 1
    AND r.time IS NOT NULL
    AND ra.year < 1975

   WHERE YEAR(races.date) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005) AS total;

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    b.bond_type,
    c.atom_id AS atom1,
    a1.element AS element1,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2,
    a2.element AS element2,

JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

    b.bond_id,
    b.molecule_id,
    b.bond_type,
    b.bond_classification,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = b.molecule_id) AS atom_count,

        b.bond_id,
        b.molecule_id,
        b.bond_type,
        CASE

    WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2'
) b;

    AND ra.year < 1975

sql:
SELECT 
    ra.year,
    AVG(
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) +
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 10, 3) AS INTEGER) * 0.001
    ) AS average_time_seconds
FROM 
    driverStandings ds
JOIN 
    drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN 
    results r ON ds.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN 
    races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE 
    ds.position = 1
    AND r.time IS NOT NULL
    AND ra.year < 1975

    b.bond_type,
    b.bond_classification,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = b.molecule_id) AS atom_count,

) b;

WITH total_drivers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT results.driverId) AS total_drivers
  FROM results
  JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
  WHERE YEAR(races.date) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
),
eligible_drivers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT results.driverId) AS eligible_drivers
  FROM results
  JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
  JOIN drivers ON results.driverId = drivers.driverId
  WHERE YEAR(races.date) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
  AND YEAR(drivers.dob) < 1985
  AND laps > 50
)
SELECT 
  (eligible_drivers.eligible_drivers * 100.0 / total_drivers.total_drivers) AS percentage
FROM total_drivers, eligible_drivers;

SELECT 
    ra.year,
    AVG(
        CASE 
            WHEN POSITION(':', r.time) > 1 THEN
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[0] AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[1] AS INTEGER) * 60 +
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[2] AS INTEGER) +
                CAST(SUBSTR(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), LENGTH(REPLACE(r.time, '+', '')) - 3) AS INTEGER) / 1000
            ELSE
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[0] AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[1] AS INTEGER) * 60
        END
    ) AS average_time_seconds
FROM 
    driverStandings ds
JOIN 
    drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN 
    results r ON ds.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN 
    races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE 
    ds.position = 1
    AND r.time IS NOT NULL
    AND ra.year < 1975
GROUP BY 
    ra.year;

    b.bond_id,
    b.molecule_id,
    b.bond_type,
    b.bond_classification,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = b.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = b.molecule_id) AS bond_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        b.bond_id,
        b.molecule_id,
        b.bond_type,
        CASE
            WHEN a1.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
            WHEN a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
            ELSE 'Other Bond Type'

    FROM connected c
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2'
) b;

sql:
SELECT 
  (COUNT(DISTINCT eligible.driverId) * 100.0 / total.total_drivers) AS percentage
FROM 
  (SELECT DISTINCT results.driverId
   FROM results
   JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
   JOIN drivers ON results.driverId = drivers.driverId
   WHERE YEAR(races.date) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
   AND YEAR(drivers.dob) < 1985
   AND laps > 50) AS eligible
JOIN 
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT driverId) AS total_drivers
   FROM results
   JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
   WHERE YEAR(races.date) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005) AS total;

    ra.year,
    AVG(
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) +
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 10, 3) AS INTEGER) * 0.001
    ) AS average_time_seconds
FROM

    drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN 
    results r ON ds.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN 
    races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE 
    ds.position = 1
    AND r.time IS NOT NULL
    AND ra.year < 1975
GROUP BY 
    ra.year;

SELECT 
    ra.year,
    AVG(
        CASE 
            WHEN POSITION(':', r.time) > 1 THEN
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[0] AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[1] AS INTEGER) * 60 +
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[2] AS INTEGER) +
                CAST(SUBSTR(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), LENGTH(REPLACE(r.time, '+', '')) - 3) AS INTEGER) / 1000
            ELSE
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[0] AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[1] AS INTEGER) * 60
        END
    ) AS average_time_seconds
FROM 
    driverStandings ds
JOIN 
    drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN 
    results r ON ds.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN 
    races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE 
    ds.position = 1
    AND r.time IS NOT NULL
    AND ra.year < 1975
GROUP BY 
    ra.year;

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    b.bond_type,
    c.atom_id AS atom1,
    a1.element AS element1,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2,
    a2.element AS element2,
    CASE
        WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    m.label AS molecule_label,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = b.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = b.molecule_id) AS bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

  (eligible_drivers.eligible_drivers * 100.0 / total_drivers.total_drivers) AS percentage
FROM 
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT results.driverId) AS eligible_drivers
   FROM results
   JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
   JOIN drivers ON results.driverId = drivers.driverId
   WHERE YEAR(races.date) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
   AND YEAR(drivers.dob) < 1985
   AND laps > 50) AS eligible_drivers,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT results.driverId) AS total_drivers
   FROM results
   JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
   WHERE YEAR(races.date) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005) AS total_drivers;

SELECT 
    ra.year,
    AVG(
        CASE 
            WHEN POSITION(':', r.time) > 1 THEN
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[0] AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[1] AS INTEGER) * 60 +
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[2] AS INTEGER) +
                CAST(SUBSTR(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), LENGTH(REPLACE(r.time, '+', '')) - 3) AS INTEGER) / 1000
            ELSE
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[0] AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
                CAST(SPLIT(REPLACE(r.time, '+', ''), ':')[1] AS INTEGER) * 60
        END
    ) AS average_time_seconds
FROM 
    driverStandings ds
JOIN 
    drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN 
    results r ON ds.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN 
    races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE 
    ds.position = 1
    AND r.time IS NOT NULL
    AND ra.year < 1975
GROUP BY 
    ra.year;

SELECT 
    ra.year,
    AVG(
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) +
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 10, 3) AS INTEGER) * 0.001
    ) AS average_time_seconds
FROM 
    driverStandings ds
JOIN 
    drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN 
    results r ON ds.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN 
    races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE 
    ds.position = 1
    AND r.time IS NOT NULL
    AND ra.year < 1975
GROUP BY 
    ra.year;

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_with_loans,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN c.client_id END) AS successfully_completed_loans,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'D' THEN c.client_id END) AS currently_in_debt,
    MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.date)) AS earliest_year,
    MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.date)) AS latest_year
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d2 ON c.district_id = d2.district_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01' AND d2.A2 = 'Sokolov';

SELECT 
  (COUNT(DISTINCT eligible.driverId) * 100.0 / total.total_drivers) AS percentage
FROM 
  (SELECT DISTINCT results.driverId
   FROM results
   JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
   JOIN drivers ON results.driverId = drivers.driverId
   WHERE YEAR(races.date) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
   AND YEAR(drivers.dob) < 1985
   AND laps > 50) AS eligible
CROSS JOIN 
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT driverId) AS total_drivers
   FROM results
   JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
   WHERE YEAR(races.date) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005) AS total;

sql:
SELECT 
    ra.year,
    AVG(
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) +
        CAST(SUBSTR(r.time, 10, 3) AS INTEGER) * 0.001
    ) AS average_time_seconds
FROM 
    driverStandings ds
JOIN 
    drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN 
    results r ON ds.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN 
    races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE 
    ds.position = 1
    AND r.time IS NOT NULL
    AND ra.year < 1975
GROUP BY 
    ra.year;

SELECT 
    state, 
    percentage_of_members
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        zip_code.state, 
        COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE position = 'Member') AS percentage_of_members
     FROM 
        member
     JOIN 
        zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code
     WHERE 
        member.position = 'Member'
     GROUP BY 
        zip_code.state)
WHERE 
    state IN ('New Jersey', 'Vermont');
